offering_description.value: Molson Coors brews beer and sells other alcoholic and nonalcoholic beverages to wholesalers, retailers, bars and restaurants. It produces and packages beverages at its own facilities and reaches consumers mainly through wholesale and retail networks.

primary_products.value: Beer; flavored malt beverages and hard seltzers; nonalcoholic beer; energy drinks; cocktail mixers

customer_segment.value: B2B: Beverage wholesalers, grocery and convenience chains, liquor stores, bars and restaurants; B2G: Canadian provincial liquor authorities that purchase beverages for resale; B2C: Consumers buying beverages at company-operated taprooms and brewery shops

end_markets.value: Beer; flavored alcoholic beverages; nonalcoholic beer; energy drinks; cocktail mixers

revenue_model.value: product sales: Packaged and draft beverages sold to wholesalers, retailers and hospitality accounts; licensing or royalties: Rights for third-party brewers to produce and sell company beer brands in selected markets

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Brews and packages beverages from agricultural ingredients and other inputs for wholesalers and retail accounts; asset operator: Runs company-owned breweries and packaging facilities that supply beverage wholesalers and retail accounts; distributor: Supplies its own and selected partner beverages to retailers, bars and restaurants in some markets; retailer: Sells company beer directly to consumers through brewery taprooms and shops
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; distributor; retailer

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Central and Eastern Europe, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Beer, flavored alcoholic beverages, nonalcoholic beer, energy drinks and cocktail mixers

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent beer and beverage wholesalers and provincial liquor distribution agencies; direct sales: Retail and hospitality accounts in markets with direct distribution; third-party retail: Grocery stores, convenience stores, liquor stores, bars and restaurants; partners / resellers: Licensed brewers and distribution partners in selected international markets; own locations: Company-operated brewery taprooms and shops
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; third-party retail; partners / resellers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Alcohol production and sales require permits or licenses, with oversight from the U.S. TTB and state and provincial alcohol authorities.
